The '''Hrthging system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hrthging]].
